conclusion: Source review clean; no blocking finding. This is not a functional, native-browser, device, or performance pass.
scope: Four-path MP3 inspection delegation and its twelve new controls only; no branch or PR mutation.

reviewed.finding: readAsset retains inspectMP3 as its default inspector, normalizes the bounded downloaded bytes to an owned native MPEG Blob before delegated inspection, checks the child abort afterward, preserves the full pinned descriptor comparison, and returns that exact immutable original identity.

The player privately captures facts only after its existing inspector succeeds during the same open acquisition. Reuse requires strict equality with the returned original Blob. Ignored, failed, late, local or different-object paths undergo ordinary validation; no general trusted flag or cross-load cache is added.

Transport, source-child and acquisition-close signals are linked and listeners removed in finally. Acquisition close aborts unawaited worker or fallback work. Existing generation, disposed and abort checks prevent late deck publication. Source 60-second and inspector 30-second deadlines are unchanged.

The existing inspector and shared preparation owner are reused. Nested reservations use separate fetch, inspect and main queues. Worker-unavailable main-thread scanning remains deferred during active play; the source child deadline and transport cancellation can retire it. Offline/export callers retain default validation and independent installation ownership.

Native Blob ownership/brand and byte-limit checks still precede use; both source and player pinned-descriptor comparisons remain. Object URLs are installed only after final validation and lifecycle checks.

Two source and ten player controls cover normalized exact identity, corrupted facts, abort, real static Node worker, local originals, ignored/same/different/failed custom callbacks, late callback, paused fallback, source timeout, unrelated signal cancellation and current-plus-next worker reuse. All twelve are source-reviewed and unexecuted.

The actual existing audio helper constructs Soundscape and tracks object URLs; the album helper supplies a real Response. The worker fixture uses a separate Node worker importing the production static module, restores the original Worker descriptor and terminates live workers. Source bytes are prepared before the main-realm Blob materialization spy. Existing bounded settleUntil timeout is unchanged.
